question: As of July 2025, what was the total quantity of narcotics seized in Jammu & Kashmir since 2018, under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act (NDPSA)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1,12,000 kg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The total quantity of **narcotics** seized in the **Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir** from **2018** to **July 2025** has reached a staggering **1,12,000 kg**. This massive recovery highlights the intensifying "War on Drugs" initiated by the **J&K Police** and central agencies.
 
• During this period, law enforcement agencies registered more than **13,000 cases** under the **Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985**. This signifies a proactive approach to dismantling the supply chains of contraband.
 
• A significant number of arrests have been made, with over **19,500 individuals** apprehended for their involvement in drug trafficking and peddling. This includes both local conduits and high-level traffickers across **districts** like **Srinagar**, **Jammu**, **Anantnag**, and **Baramulla**.
